title: Leadership, Influence & Career Growth
sub: Mentoring, influence, ownership and growing into senior roles.

cards.def:
The ability to guide and inspire others toward a goal
हिंदी: नेतृत्व क्षमता
examples: Strong leadership kept the team calm during the outage.
Leadership is not about a title; it's about taking responsibility.
She showed leadership by guiding the new joiners without being asked.
The company is investing in leadership training for young managers.

cards.def:
To give people authority and confidence to act
हिंदी: सशक्त बनाना
examples: Good managers empower engineers to make decisions.
Training empowers support staff to solve problems without escalation.
We want to empower women in rural areas through education.
The new policy empowers teams to choose their own tools.

cards.def:
To develop and nurture a quality or relationship
हिंदी: विकसित और पोषित करना
examples: She cultivated strong relationships with the business teams.
Reading every day helps you cultivate patience.
He cultivated good habits like waking early and exercising.
Cultivate a network outside your own company.

cards.def:
To encourage the development of something
हिंदी: बढ़ावा देना
examples: We want to foster a culture of open feedback.
Team lunches help foster friendship among colleagues.
Good teachers foster curiosity in their students.
The company fosters innovation through monthly hackathons.

cards.def:
To persuade or change someone's opinion
हिंदी: राय बदलना
examples: The prototype swayed the sceptics.
Don't let one bad review sway your decision.
The final speech swayed many undecided voters.
Her honest answers swayed the interview panel in her favour.

cards.def:
To help resolve a dispute between parties
हिंदी: विवाद सुलझाने में मध्यस्थता करना
examples: He mediated between the two teams on API ownership.
The HR manager mediated between the two employees.
A neutral friend mediated the argument between the brothers.
The court asked a lawyer to mediate the property dispute.

cards.def:
To reduce the intensity of a conflict
हिंदी: तनाव कम करना
examples: A calm tone helped de-escalate the situation.
The support agent apologised to de-escalate the angry customer.
Listening first is the best way to de-escalate an argument.
The police were trained to de-escalate tense situations.

cards.def:
To lead an initiative or effort
हिंदी: किसी पहल का नेतृत्व करना
examples: He spearheaded the move to automated testing.
She spearheaded the campaign to make the office plastic-free.
Who will spearhead the new market launch?
The NGO spearheaded clean-water projects in fifty villages.

cards.def:
To supervise and ensure work is done properly
हिंदी: देखरेख करना
examples: He oversees the migration across four teams.
A senior engineer will oversee the new joiners' first project.
The principal oversees all the school's activities.
She was hired to oversee the construction of the new office.

cards.def:
A person responsible for caring for something
हिंदी: देखभाल का ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति
examples: He acts as steward of the shared platform.
As steward of the company's brand, she approves every campaign.
The new CEO sees himself as a steward of the company's values.
Each dataset needs a steward who keeps it accurate.

cards.def:
Having original ideas about the future
हिंदी: दूरदर्शी
examples: The architect has a visionary approach to data platforms.
Her visionary ideas transformed a small shop into a national brand.
A visionary leader sees opportunities others miss.
The visionary plan seemed impossible ten years ago.

cards.def:
Relating to long-term planning
हिंदी: रणनीतिक
examples: This is a strategic investment, not a quick fix.
Opening an office in Bengaluru was a strategic move.
Make strategic choices about where you spend your time.
The partnership is strategic for our growth in Asia.

cards.def:
Relating to short-term actions toward a goal
हिंदी: युक्तिपरक
examples: The patch is a tactical fix while we plan the real solution.
Offering a discount was a tactical move to clear old stock.
Our tactical goal this week is to close the top ten bugs.
He's good at tactical work but needs to think long term.

cards.def:
Considering the whole rather than just the parts
हिंदी: समग्र
examples: We need a holistic view of reliability, cost and speed.
The doctor took a holistic approach to my health.
A holistic review looks at skills, attitude and teamwork.
We need a holistic plan, not separate fixes for each team.

cards.def:
The overall view or general situation
हिंदी: बड़ी तस्वीर
examples: Keep the big picture in mind while solving details.
Don't lose sight of the big picture over small details.
The CEO explained the big picture in the town hall.
In the big picture, one bad month doesn't matter much.

cards.def:
A measurable outcome showing progress towards an objective
हिंदी: मापने योग्य परिणाम
examples: One key result is zero missed file deadlines.
Our key result for the quarter is a 20 percent drop in complaints.
Each objective should have two or three key results.
We missed one key result but met the others.

cards.def:
A measurable value showing how well goals are met
हिंदी: प्रदर्शन मापक संकेतक
examples: File delivery time is our main KPI.
Customer satisfaction is a key KPI for our support team.
Choose a KPI that the team can actually influence.
We review every KPI in the monthly business meeting.

cards.def:
The degree to which work is seen and recognised
हिंदी: कार्य की दृश्यता/पहचान
examples: Increase your visibility by sharing results in team forums.
Presenting at the town hall gave her good visibility with leadership.
Quiet workers sometimes lack visibility despite doing great work.
The new dashboard gives managers visibility into project status.

cards.def:
Deserving of confidence
हिंदी: भरोसेमंद
examples: A trustworthy engineer raises issues early.
Choose a trustworthy person to handle the company's money.
He proved trustworthy by keeping confidential information private.
Look for reviews to find a trustworthy electrician.

cards.def:
Consistently reliable
हिंदी: भरोसेमंद
examples: She's the most dependable person on the team.
My old scooter is not fast, but it's dependable.
We need a dependable vendor who delivers on time.
She is dependable, so I gave her the most important task.

cards.def:
A person who works without needing direction
हिंदी: स्वयं पहल करने वाला
examples: We want a self-starter who can pick up ambiguous problems.
As a self-starter, she set up the new project without waiting for instructions.
Startups prefer self-starters who don't need daily guidance.
Mention in your interview that you're a self-starter, with an example.

cards.def:
An ambitious person who actively pursues goals
हिंदी: महत्वाकांक्षी और सक्रिय व्यक्ति
examples: He's a go-getter who volunteers for challenging tasks.
She's a real go-getter who started a business at twenty-two.
Sales roles suit go-getters who love targets.
The new intern is a go-getter and asks for more work.

cards.def:
Able to find clever solutions with limited means
हिंदी: संसाधनपूर्ण / तरकीबी
examples: A resourceful engineer finds a way around blockers.
When the power went out, she was resourceful and used her phone light.
Resourceful students find free courses online.
The team was resourceful and reused old servers for testing.

cards.def:
Able to adjust to new conditions
हिंदी: परिस्थिति के अनुसार ढलने वाला
examples: Adaptable teams recover quickly from changing priorities.
Be adaptable when plans change at the last minute.
Children are very adaptable to new schools.
Adaptable employees do well in fast-growing companies.

cards.def:
Able to move and respond quickly
हिंदी: फुर्तीला
examples: We stay agile by releasing small changes often.
Small companies can be more agile than big ones.
An agile team quickly changes direction when the market shifts.
She stayed agile by learning new tools every year.

cards.def:
Having a balanced set of skills
हिंदी: संतुलित क्षमताओं वाला
examples: Senior roles need well-rounded engineers, not just coders.
A well-rounded student does well in studies and sports.
Reading widely helps you become a well-rounded professional.
We want a well-rounded candidate with both technical and people skills.

cards.def:
Having deep expertise in one area and broad knowledge in others
हिंदी: एक क्षेत्र में गहरा और बाकी में व्यापक ज्ञान
examples: Our best engineers are T-shaped.
A T-shaped designer knows design deeply and understands coding basics.
Becoming T-shaped helps you work well with other teams.
Hiring T-shaped people makes small teams more flexible.

cards.def:
A person with deep knowledge in a particular area
हिंदी: विषय विशेषज्ञ
examples: She's our subject matter expert on market data vendors.
We invited a subject matter expert to explain the tax rules.
He is the subject matter expert on our billing system.
Ask a subject matter expert to review the training content.

cards.def:
An expert whose ideas influence others
हिंदी: विचार-नेता
examples: He became a thought leader on data resilience.
She writes weekly articles and is seen as a thought leader in HR.
Speaking at conferences can make you a thought leader.
The company invited thought leaders to its annual summit.

cards.def:
The person others turn to for help in a topic
हिंदी: जिनसे सब सलाह लेते हैं
examples: She's the go-to person for Kafka issues.
He's the go-to person for anything related to Excel.
Become the go-to person for one skill on your team.
My neighbour is the go-to person for plumbing advice.

cards.def:
Someone or something that greatly increases others' effectiveness
हिंदी: दूसरों की क्षमता बढ़ाने वाला
examples: Good tooling is a force multiplier for the whole team.
A good mentor is a force multiplier for junior engineers.
Automation has been a force multiplier for our small team.
She acts as a force multiplier by unblocking others.

cards.def:
A pioneer who creates a new path
हिंदी: नई राह बनाने वाला
examples: She's a trailblazer in adopting infrastructure as code.
She was a trailblazer as the first woman engineer in her town.
The startup was a trailblazer in online grocery delivery.
Trailblazers often face criticism before success.

cards.def:
Involving people from different specialities
हिंदी: विभिन्न विशेषज्ञताओं को जोड़ने वाला
examples: A cross-functional team ships features faster.
The launch needs a cross-functional team of sales, design and engineering.
Cross-functional meetings help avoid surprises late in the project.
She led a cross-functional project for the first time.

cards.def:
Working jointly with others on a task
हिंदी: सहयोग
examples: Collaboration between engineers and analysts improved data quality.
The project succeeded because of strong collaboration across teams.
Online tools make collaboration easy for remote teams.
The film was a collaboration between two famous directors.

cards.def:
Combined effect greater than the sum of parts
हिंदी: सहयोग से बढ़ा हुआ प्रभाव
examples: There's real synergy between the platform and data teams.
The merger created synergy between the two sales teams.
There's good synergy between the designer and the developer.
The companies hoped for synergy, but cultures clashed.

cards.def:
A harmonious relationship of mutual understanding
हिंदी: आपसी तालमेल
examples: Building rapport with stakeholders makes negotiations easier.
She quickly built rapport with the new client.
A good teacher has rapport with students.
Small talk before a meeting helps build rapport.

cards.def:
Friendship and mutual trust within a group
हिंदी: मित्रवत साथ
examples: The team's camaraderie helped us through a tough quarter.
There's great camaraderie among the night-shift workers.
Team sports build camaraderie among colleagues.
The camaraderie in our old office is what I miss most.

cards.def:
A climate where people feel safe to speak up
हिंदी: बोलने में सुरक्षित महसूस करने का वातावरण
examples: Psychological safety lets people admit mistakes early.
Psychological safety helps new joiners ask basic questions.
Teams with psychological safety share bad news quickly.
The manager built psychological safety by admitting her own mistakes.

cards.def:
Focused on learning rather than assigning fault
हिंदी: दोषारोपण से मुक्त
examples: We hold blameless postmortems after every incident.
A blameless culture encourages people to report problems.
Keep the review blameless and focus on the process.
The blameless report named no individuals, only the gaps.

cards.def:
Open and honest about information
हिंदी: पारदर्शी
examples: Be transparent about risks, even when the news is bad.
Be transparent with customers about the delay.
The company is transparent about salary bands.
A transparent process makes promotions feel fair.

cards.def:
Honest and open expression
हिंदी: स्पष्टवादिता
examples: Her candour about delays built trust with the client.
I appreciate your candour, even though it was hard to hear.
His candour in the interview impressed the panel.
Leaders who show candour earn more trust.

cards.def:
A cycle where results inform future actions
हिंदी: प्रतिक्रिया चक्र
examples: A fast feedback loop helps us catch issues early.
Weekly user calls create a quick feedback loop for the product team.
A short feedback loop helps students learn faster.
Code reviews are an important feedback loop for developers.

cards.def:
Specific enough to act upon
हिंदी: कार्रवाई योग्य
examples: Give actionable feedback, not general criticism.
The survey gave us actionable ideas to improve the office.
Turn the meeting notes into actionable tasks with owners.
Generic advice isn't helpful; make it actionable.

cards.def:
To learn new skills to stay relevant
हिंदी: नए कौशल सीखना
examples: I'm upskilling in cloud security this year.
The company pays for courses to help staff upskill.
Upskill regularly to stay valuable in a changing job market.
She upskilled in data analysis and got a promotion.

cards.def:
To learn entirely new skills for a different role
हिंदी: नए क्षेत्र के कौशल सीखना
examples: Many analysts reskilled into data engineering.
After the factory closed, many workers reskilled as electricians.
The government runs programmes to reskill unemployed youth.
He reskilled from teaching to software testing.

cards.def:
A high degree of skill
हिंदी: दक्षता
examples: Proficiency in system design is expected at senior level.
The job requires proficiency in English and Hindi.
Her proficiency with spreadsheets saves the team hours.
You can show your language proficiency with a certificate.

cards.def:
The quality of a person's ability
हिंदी: योग्यता का स्तर
examples: The team hired engineers of exceptional calibre.
Players of his calibre are rare.
The calibre of applicants this year was very high.
We need a leader of real calibre for this role.

cards.def:
A history of past achievements
हिंदी: पिछली उपलब्धियों का रिकॉर्ड
examples: She has a strong track record of delivering on time.
The builder has a good track record of finishing on time.
With your track record, you should apply for the senior role.
The startup has no track record, so investors are careful.

cards.def:
Something successfully achieved
हिंदी: उपलब्धि
examples: List measurable accomplishments on your resume.
Running my first marathon was a big accomplishment.
Celebrate small accomplishments to keep the team motivated.
Her biggest accomplishment was cutting costs by thirty percent.

cards.def:
Reaching a significant point of progress
हिंदी: महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि
examples: The launch was a milestone achievement for the team.
Crossing one lakh users was a milestone achievement for the app.
Her first promotion was a milestone achievement in her career.
We celebrated the milestone achievement with cake in the office.

cards.def:
A periodic evaluation of an employee's work
हिंदी: कार्य-प्रदर्शन समीक्षा
examples: Prepare examples before your performance review.
My performance review is scheduled for next week.
Keep notes on your wins through the year for the performance review.
The performance review led to a good raise.

cards.def:
An evaluation of one's own performance
हिंदी: स्वयं का मूल्यांकन
examples: Be specific and honest in your self-assessment.
The self-assessment form asks about your strengths and weaknesses.
Use numbers in your self-assessment to show impact.
Writing a self-assessment helped me see how much I'd grown.

cards.def:
A skill or aspect needing development
हिंदी: सुधार का क्षेत्र
examples: My growth area is presenting to senior leaders.
My manager said time management is my main growth area.
Mention one honest growth area when asked about weaknesses.
Public speaking used to be a growth area, but I've improved.

cards.def:
A challenging task beyond a person's current level
हिंदी: चुनौतीपूर्ण अतिरिक्त ज़िम्मेदारी
examples: The migration was a stretch assignment for me.
Leading the client workshop was a stretch assignment for her.
Ask your manager for a stretch assignment if you want to grow.
The stretch assignment helped him get promoted within a year.

cards.def:
The path of someone's professional progress
हिंदी: करियर की दिशा
examples: Leading incidents has shaped my career trajectory.
An MBA changed her career trajectory completely.
Think about your career trajectory before accepting the offer.
His career trajectory went from support to product management.

cards.def:
The structured progression of job levels
हिंदी: पदोन्नति की सीढ़ी
examples: The company defines expectations at each rung of the career ladder.
She climbed the career ladder quickly at the bank.
Moving up the career ladder isn't the only way to grow.
Our company has a separate career ladder for engineers and managers.

cards.def:
A job change to a similar level in a different area
हिंदी: समान स्तर पर दूसरे क्षेत्र में बदलाव
examples: A lateral move into data engineering broadened my skills.
A lateral move to marketing gave her a fresh start.
He made a lateral move to work closer to home.
Don't see a lateral move as a step back; it builds new skills.

cards.def:
An employee who doesn't manage others
हिंदी: बिना टीम संभाले योगदान देने वाला कर्मचारी
examples: You can grow as an individual contributor without managing people.
As an individual contributor, I focus on design and coding.
Many great individual contributors don't want to become managers.
Her role changed from individual contributor to team lead.

cards.def:
A senior technical role focused on cross-team impact
हिंदी: वरिष्ठ तकनीकी भूमिका
examples: A staff engineer shapes technical direction across teams.
He was promoted to staff engineer after leading two major projects.
The staff engineer mentors seniors across several teams.
Becoming a staff engineer needs influence beyond your own team.

cards.def:
An engineer who guides a team's technical decisions
हिंदी: तकनीकी अगुआ
examples: The tech lead reviews all design proposals.
Our tech lead decides which framework the team uses.
As tech lead, she balances coding with planning.
Ask the tech lead before changing the database design.

cards.def:
The range of people and decisions one affects
हिंदी: प्रभाव का दायरा
examples: Senior engineers widen their span of influence.
Her span of influence grew when she began leading the guild.
A manager's span of influence includes hiring decisions.
Mentoring juniors widens your span of influence.

cards.def:
The area in which someone has influence
हिंदी: प्रभाव क्षेत्र
examples: Focus on what's within your sphere of influence.
Pricing is outside my sphere of influence.
The minister's sphere of influence covers the whole state.
Grow your sphere of influence by helping other teams.

cards.def:
Handling expectations and communication with interested parties
हिंदी: हितधारकों के साथ संवाद प्रबंधन
examples: Stakeholder management is half of a lead's job.
Good stakeholder management means no surprises for the client.
She is strong technically but needs to improve stakeholder management.
Weekly updates are a simple part of stakeholder management.

cards.def:
Agreeing clearly on what will be delivered
हिंदी: अपेक्षाओं का स्पष्ट निर्धारण
examples: Early expectation setting prevents painful surprises.
Clear expectation setting with the client saved us many arguments.
Expectation setting is important when you start a new job.
Poor expectation setting led to an unhappy customer.

cards.def:
To work effectively with and support one's manager
हिंदी: अपने प्रबंधक के साथ प्रभावी तालमेल बनाना
examples: Learning to manage up helps you get the support you need.
Managing up includes sharing bad news with your boss early.
She manages up well by sending short weekly summaries.
Learning to manage up made my one-on-ones more useful.

cards.def:
To publicly support something on behalf of others
हिंदी: पक्ष में आवाज़ उठाना
examples: He advocated for more time to pay down technical debt.
She advocated for better maternity leave in the company.
Who will advocate for the users in this meeting?
Learn to advocate for yourself during appraisals.

cards.def:
To become involved to help or solve a problem
हिंदी: मदद के लिए आगे आना
examples: She stepped in to resolve the vendor dispute.
When the presenter fell ill, his colleague stepped in.
The teacher stepped in to stop the fight.
The manager had to step in when the deadline was at risk.

cards.def:
To admit a mistake honestly
हिंदी: ग़लती स्वीकार करना
examples: He owned up to the config error immediately.
The student owned up to breaking the window.
It takes courage to own up to a mistake in front of the team.
If you own up early, people will trust you more.

cards.def:
To continue something until it's finished
हिंदी: काम पूरा होने तक डटे रहना
examples: She saw the migration through to the end.
It was a hard project, but we saw it through.
Once you start the course, see it through to the end.
He promised to see the hiring process through before leaving.

cards.def:
To take responsibility for your own commitments
हिंदी: अपनी जवाबदेही खुद तय करना
examples: Hold yourself accountable for deadlines you set.
Hold yourself accountable for your daily exercise goal.
Great leaders hold themselves accountable before blaming others.
I hold myself accountable by sharing my weekly goals with my manager.

cards.def:
To behave in a way that others will follow
हिंदी: उदाहरण पेश कर नेतृत्व करना
examples: Good leaders lead by example during incidents.
Parents should lead by example and avoid phones at dinner.
The manager led by example and arrived on time every day.
If you want people to document their work, lead by example.

cards.def:
To act in accordance with what one says
हिंदी: कथनी और करनी एक रखना
examples: She walks the talk on code quality.
He talks about saving money but never walks the talk.
Our CEO walks the talk on work-life balance and logs off at six.
Companies must walk the talk on sustainability.

cards.def:
To act first without being told
हिंदी: आगे बढ़कर पहल करना
examples: She took the initiative to improve onboarding docs.
She took the initiative and organised the farewell party.
Take the initiative to learn the new tool before it's required.
Managers notice people who take the initiative.

cards.word: step out of your comfort zone
cards.def:
To try something unfamiliar and challenging
हिंदी: सहज दायरे से बाहर निकलना
examples: Presenting to executives pushed me out of my comfort zone.
Moving to a new city made me step out of my comfort zone.
Step out of your comfort zone and speak at the next meeting.
Learning to swim at forty meant stepping out of my comfort zone.

cards.def:
To start a new role or task with immediate effectiveness
हिंदी: पहले दिन से प्रभावी शुरुआत करना
examples: She hit the ground running and fixed bugs in week one.
We need someone who can hit the ground running on Monday.
Good onboarding helps new hires hit the ground running.
He hit the ground running and closed two deals in his first month.

cards.def:
To do your fair share of work
हिंदी: अपने हिस्से का काम करना
examples: Everyone on the team has to pull their weight.
In a small startup, everyone must pull their weight.
My flatmate doesn't pull his weight with the housework.
If one person doesn't pull their weight, the team suffers.

cards.def:
To take on a large share of the work
हिंदी: ज़्यादा काम का बोझ उठाना
examples: He carried the load while the team was short-staffed.
She carried the load while her colleague was on leave.
The senior players carried the load in the final match.
It's not fair for one person to always carry the load.

cards.def:
To have many different roles or responsibilities
हिंदी: कई भूमिकाएँ निभाना
examples: In a small team, you wear many hats.
At home, mothers often wear many hats.
As a founder, he wears many hats, from sales to coding.
I enjoy wearing many hats in a small company.

cards.def:
To manage several tasks simultaneously
हिंदी: एक साथ कई काम संभालना
examples: She juggles incident work and roadmap planning.
She juggles a full-time job and evening classes.
I'm juggling three projects this month.
It's hard to juggle family and work during exams.

cards.def:
To handle more than one task at a time
हिंदी: एक साथ कई काम करना
examples: Constant multitasking reduces the quality of deep work.
I can't multitask while driving; I need full focus.
People think they can multitask, but quality suffers.
Don't multitask during interviews; give the candidate your attention.

cards.def:
Shifting attention between different tasks
हिंदी: एक काम से दूसरे पर ध्यान बदलना
examples: Context switching is the biggest productivity drain.
Too many meetings cause constant context switching.
Group similar tasks together to reduce context switching.
Context switching between projects tires me out by evening.

cards.def:
Focused work free from distraction
हिंदी: एकाग्र होकर किया गया काम
examples: Block mornings for deep work.
I turn off notifications for two hours of deep work.
Writing a strategy document needs deep work, not quick replies.
Our team has a no-meeting afternoon for deep work.

cards.def:
Healthy division of time between work and personal life
हिंदी: काम और निजी जीवन का संतुलन
examples: Good work-life balance reduces burnout.
Flexible hours help employees maintain work-life balance.
She left the job because there was no work-life balance.
Work-life balance means different things to different people.

cards.def:
A calm and controlled state of mind
हिंदी: धैर्य और संयम
examples: He maintained his composure during the escalation.
She kept her composure when the client shouted.
He lost his composure and walked out of the meeting.
Deep breaths help me regain composure before a speech.

cards.def:
Calm confidence under pressure
हिंदी: संतुलित आत्मविश्वास
examples: She handled tough questions with poise.
The young singer performed with remarkable poise.
She answered the reporter's questions with poise and humour.
Practice gives you poise in front of large audiences.

cards.def:
Calm and sensible
हिंदी: शांत और समझदार
examples: A levelheaded response prevented panic.
We need a levelheaded person to handle customer complaints.
My father stayed levelheaded when our car broke down at night.
Her levelheaded advice stopped me from quitting in anger.

cards.def:
Firmly committed and unwavering
हिंदी: अडिग
examples: She was steadfast in her commitment to quality.
Her parents were steadfast in their support during her studies.
He remained steadfast in his belief that the product would succeed.
A steadfast friend stays with you in hard times.

cards.def:
Careful and thorough in doing one's work
हिंदी: कर्तव्यनिष्ठ
examples: A conscientious reviewer catches subtle bugs.
She is a conscientious student who never misses a deadline.
A conscientious employee double-checks numbers before sending them.
Be conscientious about protecting customer data.

cards.def:
Devoted to a task or purpose
हिंदी: समर्पित
examples: A dedicated team worked through the weekend.
The nurses are dedicated to their patients.
He is dedicated to learning English every day.
We have a dedicated team for large customers.

cards.def:
Pledged to a cause or activity
हिंदी: प्रतिबद्ध
examples: We're committed to delivering by the end of March.
The company is committed to reducing its carbon footprint.
I'm committed to finishing this course by June.
Only committed members should join the core team.

cards.def:
Having strong enthusiasm for something
हिंदी: उत्साही / जुनूनी
examples: He's passionate about clean architecture.
She is passionate about teaching children to read.
Be passionate in your interview, but stay professional.
He's passionate about cricket and watches every match.

cards.def:
Motivated by a strong desire to succeed
हिंदी: लक्ष्य के प्रति प्रेरित
examples: A driven engineer seeks out hard problems.
She is driven and studies at night to get ahead.
Driven people set their own goals without being pushed.
He is so driven that he sometimes forgets to rest.

cards.def:
A challenging target requiring significant effort
हिंदी: महत्वाकांक्षी लक्ष्य
examples: They set an ambitious goal of zero downtime.
Our ambitious goal is to double sales in one year.
Saving ten lakh rupees in two years is an ambitious goal.
An ambitious goal motivates the team if it's realistic.

cards.def:
To flourish and grow successfully
हिंदी: फलना-फूलना
examples: She thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving projects.
Plants thrive in this sunny balcony.
Some people thrive under pressure.
Small businesses thrive when customers shop locally.

cards.def:
To grow and develop successfully
हिंदी: पनपना
examples: Mentored engineers tend to flourish quickly.
The town flourished after the new highway opened.
Her painting skills flourished after she joined the class.
Good ideas flourish in an open team culture.

cards.def:
To be exceptionally good at something
हिंदी: उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन करना
examples: He excels at explaining complex systems simply.
She excels at maths but struggles with writing.
Our team excels at customer support.
He excelled in his first year and got a quick promotion.

cards.def:
To do better than expected or others
हिंदी: अपेक्षा से बेहतर प्रदर्शन करना
examples: The new design outperformed the old one by far.
The new phone outperforms older models on battery life.
Our team outperformed its targets this quarter.
Small cap funds outperformed large caps last year.

cards.def:
To do better than what was anticipated
हिंदी: अपेक्षाओं से आगे निकलना
examples: The team exceeded expectations by delivering early.
The hotel exceeded our expectations with its service.
Her first project exceeded expectations in quality and speed.
Under-promise and over-deliver to exceed expectations.

cards.def:
To perform well in a challenging situation
हिंदी: चुनौती पर खरा उतरना
examples: She rose to the occasion during the outage.
The young bowler rose to the occasion in the final over.
When the manager fell sick, she rose to the occasion.
I was nervous, but I rose to the occasion in the interview.

cards.def:
To have a positive effect
हिंदी: फ़र्क़ पैदा करना
examples: Clear documentation makes a real difference to new joiners.
Small donations can make a difference to poor families.
A kind word from a manager can make a difference to morale.
I want a job where I can make a difference.

cards.def:
To have a strong effect on something
हिंदी: गहरा प्रभाव डालना
examples: You can make an impact by solving customer pain points.
She made an impact in her first month by fixing the billing errors.
The new policy made an impact on employee retention.
If you want to make an impact, focus on fewer goals.

cards.def:
To contribute something useful or beneficial
हिंदी: मूल्य जोड़ना
examples: Think about how your work adds value to the business.
Ask yourself if this meeting adds value.
A good consultant adds value beyond what the client expects.
Fresh graduates can add value with new ideas.

cards.def:
A brief persuasive summary of an idea
हिंदी: संक्षिप्त प्रेरक परिचय
examples: Prepare a thirty-second elevator pitch for your project.
She practised her elevator pitch before the networking event.
Your elevator pitch should explain what you do in one breath.
The founder's elevator pitch impressed the investor in the lift.

cards.def:
A short overview for senior readers
हिंदी: वरिष्ठों के लिए संक्षिप्त सारांश
examples: Start the report with an executive summary.
The CEO only reads the executive summary.
Write the executive summary last, after the full report.
Keep the executive summary to one page.

cards.def:
To show or explain something to an audience
हिंदी: प्रस्तुत करना
examples: I'll present the findings at Thursday's review.
She will present the new product to the board.
Practise twice before you present to the client.
Each intern presents their project on the last day.

cards.def:
A commanding, confident manner that inspires trust
हिंदी: प्रभावशाली व आत्मविश्वासी व्यक्तित्व
examples: Executive presence helps you influence senior leaders.
Speaking slowly and clearly helps build executive presence.
He has the skills, but he needs more executive presence.
Executive presence includes staying calm when challenged.

cards.def:
Dignity and seriousness of manner
हिंदी: गंभीरता और प्रभाव
examples: She speaks with gravitas about reliability.
The senior doctor's words carried gravitas.
His deep voice gives him gravitas in meetings.
She lacked gravitas at first but grew into the role.

cards.def:
To claim recognition for work
हिंदी: श्रेय लेना
examples: Don't take credit for work the team did.
He loves to take credit but avoids blame.
She refused to take credit and thanked her team instead.
It's fine to take credit for your own good work.

cards.def:
To give others recognition
हिंदी: दूसरों को भी श्रेय देना
examples: Great leaders share the spotlight.
The captain shared the spotlight with the young players.
Share the spotlight by naming everyone who helped.
A confident leader is happy to share the spotlight.

cards.def:
A senior person who advocates for your career
हिंदी: वरिष्ठ संरक्षक जो आगे बढ़ाए
examples: A sponsor recommended her for the lead role.
Finding a sponsor can speed up your promotion.
Her sponsor spoke up for her in the leadership meeting.
A mentor gives advice, but a sponsor opens doors.

cards.def:
A meeting with your manager's manager
हिंदी: प्रबंधक के प्रबंधक से बैठक
examples: A skip-level meeting gives a broader view of priorities.
In the skip-level meeting, I shared ideas about our process.
Our director holds a skip-level meeting with each team every quarter.
Prepare a few questions before your skip-level meeting.

cards.def:
A private meeting between two people
हिंदी: आमने-सामने की बैठक
examples: Use your one-on-one to discuss career goals.
My manager and I have a one-on-one every Tuesday.
Don't cancel one-on-ones just because you're busy.
I raised my workload concern in our one-on-one.

cards.def:
A discussion about professional growth
हिंदी: करियर विकास पर चर्चा
examples: I asked for a career conversation with my manager.
After the career conversation, I knew what skills to build.
Managers should have a career conversation with each person twice a year.
A good career conversation focuses on your goals, not just the next role.

cards.def:
A structured plan for building skills
हिंदी: कौशल विकास योजना
examples: We agreed on a six-month development plan.
My development plan includes a leadership course.
Review your development plan with your manager every quarter.
The development plan helped her move into a senior role.

cards.def:
The difference between current and required skills
हिंदी: कौशल का अंतर
examples: We identified a skill gap in cloud security.
Training can close the skill gap in our support team.
There is a skill gap between college learning and industry needs.
He identified his own skill gap and joined an online course.

cards.def:
Passing expertise from one person to another
हिंदी: ज्ञान का हस्तांतरण
examples: Knowledge transfer prevents single-person dependency.
Plan two weeks of knowledge transfer before you leave the job.
The knowledge transfer sessions were recorded for future joiners.
Poor knowledge transfer left the new team confused.

cards.def:
The number of people whose absence would stall a project
हिंदी: कितने लोगों के जाने से काम रुक जाए
examples: Our bus factor on this service is one.
Increase the bus factor by documenting the setup steps.
Our bus factor improved after we trained two more people.
A bus factor of one is a big risk for any project.

cards.def:
Preparing people to take over key roles
हिंदी: उत्तराधिकारी तैयार करना
examples: Succession planning reduces risk when leads leave.
Succession planning ensures someone can replace the CEO if needed.
Family businesses often ignore succession planning.
Good succession planning keeps the team stable after promotions.

cards.def:
A position created to replace a departing employee
हिंदी: जाने वाले कर्मचारी की जगह भरने वाली नियुक्ति
examples: We're hiring a backfill for the senior engineer.
The backfill role will be open until we find the right person.
We got approval for a backfill role after she resigned.
Interviews for the backfill role start next week.

cards.def:
Gradual loss of employees
हिंदी: कर्मचारियों का धीरे-धीरे छोड़ना
examples: High attrition hurt delivery.
The company is worried about attrition after the bonus cut.
Attrition in call centres is usually very high.
Better pay helped reduce attrition this year.

cards.def:
The ability to keep employees
हिंदी: कर्मचारियों को रोके रखना
examples: Good culture improves retention.
Flexible work is a big factor in employee retention.
Customer retention is cheaper than finding new customers.
The bank offers bonuses to improve retention of top performers.

cards.def:
The confidence and enthusiasm of a group
हिंदी: टीम का मनोबल
examples: Frequent outages lowered team morale.
Team morale went up after the successful launch.
A sudden policy change hurt staff morale.
Celebrating small wins keeps morale high.

cards.def:
The level of commitment and enthusiasm at work
हिंदी: कार्य में जुड़ाव
examples: Autonomy increases employee engagement.
The engagement survey showed people want more growth opportunities.
Employee engagement drops when people feel ignored.
Regular feedback improves engagement in remote teams.

cards.def:
To control every detail of someone's work
हिंदी: हर छोटी बात पर नियंत्रण रखना
examples: Micromanaging kills creativity.
Please don't micromanage the team; trust them to deliver.
She left because her boss micromanaged every email.
New managers sometimes micromanage because they're nervous.

cards.def:
Not directly involved; allowing independence
हिंदी: हस्तक्षेप न करने वाला
examples: He takes a hands-off approach with senior engineers.
My parents were hands-off and let me choose my career.
A hands-off manager works well with experienced people.
Being too hands-off can leave new joiners feeling lost.

cards.def:
Friendly and easy to talk to
हिंदी: सहज उपलब्ध और मिलनसार
examples: An approachable lead encourages questions.
Our principal is approachable and listens to every student.
Being approachable helps managers hear problems early.
She's senior, but very approachable and friendly.

cards.def:
Able to understand others' feelings
हिंदी: संवेदनशील / सहानुभूतिपूर्ण
examples: Empathetic managers handle conflict better.
An empathetic doctor makes patients feel heard.
Be empathetic when a colleague is going through a hard time.
Empathetic listening calmed the upset customer.

cards.def:
Providing encouragement and help
हिंदी: सहयोगी
examples: Her supportive feedback built my confidence.
My family was very supportive when I changed careers.
A supportive team makes hard projects easier.
Thank you for being so supportive during my first month.

cards.def:
Able to make decisions quickly and effectively
हिंदी: निर्णायक
examples: A decisive lead prevents endless debate.
In an emergency, you need someone decisive.
She was decisive and chose the vendor in one meeting.
Be decisive, but stay open to new information.

cards.def:
Unable to make decisions
हिंदी: अनिर्णायक
examples: Indecisive leadership delays delivery.
I'm so indecisive that I take ages to order food.
An indecisive client kept changing the requirements.
Being indecisive in a crisis can make things worse.

cards.def:
Having great influence on others
हिंदी: प्रभावशाली
examples: She is an influential voice in design reviews.
She is influential in the local business community.
His blog became influential among young developers.
Teachers are influential in shaping children's values.

cards.def:
A person whose opinion is trusted
हिंदी: विश्वसनीय आवाज़
examples: He became a credible voice on data quality.
She's a credible voice on women's health.
Build a track record to become a credible voice in your field.
When a credible voice raises a risk, leaders listen.

cards.def:
To develop confidence between people
हिंदी: भरोसा बनाना
examples: Delivering small promises builds trust.
Being on time for meetings helps build trust.
It takes years to build trust and seconds to lose it.
New managers should build trust before making big changes.

cards.def:
To gain admiration through actions
हिंदी: सम्मान अर्जित करना
examples: You earn respect by listening first.
You can't demand respect; you have to earn respect.
She earned respect by always keeping her promises.
The new coach earned respect by working harder than the players.

cards.def:
To define acceptable limits
हिंदी: सीमाएँ तय करना
examples: Set boundaries to protect your focus time.
Set boundaries so work calls don't happen after nine at night.
It's healthy to set boundaries with demanding relatives.
She set boundaries early, and her team respected them.

cards.def:
To decline politely and professionally
हिंदी: विनम्रता से मना करना
examples: Learn to say no gracefully to low-priority requests.
It's hard for me to say no gracefully to my relatives.
Say no gracefully by offering another time or option.
She said no gracefully, and the client still felt valued.

cards.def:
To discuss a salary increase
हिंदी: वेतन वृद्धि पर बातचीत करना
examples: Prepare evidence before you negotiate a raise.
Check market salaries before you negotiate a raise.
He negotiated a raise after taking on more responsibility.
The best time to negotiate a raise is after a big success.

cards.def:
To justify a proposal with benefits and costs
हिंदी: व्यावसायिक औचित्य प्रस्तुत करना
examples: She made a business case for hiring two engineers.
Make a business case before you ask for new laptops.
He made a business case showing the tool would save money.
Without a strong business case, the project won't be approved.

cards.def:
To obtain money for a project
हिंदी: धन की व्यवस्था करना
examples: We secured funding for the platform upgrade.
The startup secured funding from two investors.
We need to secure funding before we can hire.
The school secured funding for a new science lab.

cards.def:
To gain someone's support
हिंदी: समर्थन जीतना
examples: His demo won over the sceptical director.
The salesperson won over the customer with honest advice.
It took months to win over my new manager.
Her cooking won over the whole family.

cards.def:
To gain agreement and support from everyone
हिंदी: सबको साथ लेना
examples: We need to get everyone on board before launching.
It took a few meetings to get everyone on board with the new tool.
Get everyone on board with the plan before the trip.
The manager got everyone on board by explaining the reasons.

cards.def:
To contribute skills or value
हिंदी: योगदान या कौशल लाना
examples: She brings deep domain expertise to the table.
What skills do you bring to the table?
Each partner brings something different to the table.
He brings years of client experience to the table.

cards.def:
To perform better than expected for your size or level
हिंदी: अपने स्तर से बेहतर प्रदर्शन करना
examples: The small team punches above its weight.
Our small startup punches above its weight against big brands.
The junior analyst punches above her weight in client meetings.
The tiny country punches above its weight in sports.

cards.def:
A reliable person who can be trusted with tasks
हिंदी: भरोसेमंद व्यक्ति
examples: He is a safe pair of hands for critical releases.
The manager chose him because he's a safe pair of hands.
For the audit, we need a safe pair of hands.
She proved to be a safe pair of hands during the crisis.

cards.def:
Someone who cooperates well with others
हिंदी: टीम भावना वाला व्यक्ति
examples: We value a team player over a lone hero.
Be a team player and help your colleague finish on time.
The coach wants team players, not just stars.
He is a team player who shares credit generously.

cards.def:
Someone who learns fast
हिंदी: जल्दी सीखने वाला
examples: She's a quick study and mastered Kafka in weeks.
The new intern is a quick study and needs little training.
She's a quick study, so she'll learn our tools fast.
Being a quick study helped him in his first job.

cards.def:
A person who picks up new skills quickly
हिंदी: तेज़ी से सीखने वाला
examples: As a fast learner, he adapted to the new stack.
I'm a fast learner and enjoy new challenges.
As a fast learner, she was handling clients within a month.
Show you're a fast learner with a real example, not just a claim.

cards.def:
A person who is rapidly becoming successful
हिंदी: उभरता सितारा
examples: She's a rising star in the platform team.
The young singer is a rising star in Bollywood.
Management sees him as a rising star in sales.
Rising stars need mentors to keep growing.

cards.def:
A person who contributes a lot without recognition
हिंदी: अनदेखा नायक
examples: The on-call engineers are the unsung heroes.
The cleaning staff are the unsung heroes of the hospital.
She was an unsung hero who quietly fixed many issues.
Let's thank the unsung heroes behind this successful event.

cards.def:
A highly experienced person
हिंदी: अनुभवी पेशेवर
examples: A seasoned professional stays calm in crises.
The new CFO is a seasoned professional with twenty years in banking.
A seasoned professional knows when to ask for help.
We need a seasoned professional to lead the negotiation.

cards.def:
A team that works very smoothly
हिंदी: सुचारू रूप से चलने वाली टीम
examples: After a year, the team ran like a well-oiled machine.
The restaurant kitchen runs like a well-oiled machine.
By the third event, our team was a well-oiled machine.
Good processes turn a group into a well-oiled machine.

cards.def:
A close and supportive group
हिंदी: आपस में जुड़ी टीम
examples: A tight-knit team communicates with little friction.
Our building has a tight-knit community of families.
The small office has a tight-knit team that celebrates every birthday.
Joining a tight-knit team can feel hard at first.

cards.def:
A group consistently achieving excellent results
हिंदी: उच्च प्रदर्शन करने वाली टीम
examples: High-performing teams value feedback.
A high-performing team needs trust as much as talent.
She built a high-performing team from scratch.
High-performing teams set clear goals and measure progress.

cards.def:
A demanding request
हिंदी: कठिन माँग
examples: Delivering in two weeks is a steep ask.
Asking a new joiner to lead the project is a steep ask.
Getting the client to pay double is a steep ask.
I know it's a steep ask, but can you work this Saturday?
